baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا presents an active sending from above onto the addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sending supplies controlled release, the sky supplies an overhead source, and midrār supplies copious output from that source; together they form an opened overhead supply that keeps delivering rain.

activation_trace.role: Sending forth and release make the verb the opening action of the supply mechanism.
The overhead sky or cover supplies the elevated source from which the released water descends.
Abundant yielding from a source makes midrār sustained productive outflow rather than a bare mention of rain.

changed_reading.before: He sends abundant rain upon you.
changed_reading.after: He actively opens an overhead source so that it keeps yielding copiously onto you.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The pairing of يُرْسِلِ with the intensive مِّدْرَارًا can describe the temporal shape of the descent.
baseline_models.mechanism: Successive dispatched batches combine with copious source-yield to model replenishing showers arriving one after another, not one undifferentiated burst.

activation_trace.role: Succession in batches gives the sending a serial rhythm of one released group after another.
Copious source-yield turns the serial releases into a sustained and replenishing water supply.

changed_reading.before: The clause promises a single large downpour.
changed_reading.after: The clause can promise rain in continuing, successively dispatched yields.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical contact between يُرْسِلِ and مِّدْرَارًا concentrates on a source giving a continuous yield.
baseline_models.mechanism: The sending inventory itself includes milk and repeated yield, while the dr-r inventory joins milk and rain as abundant output; willing prosperity then frames the sky as a nourishing provisioner rather than only a weather location.

activation_trace.role: Milk and flowing yield make the act of sending resemble the sustained release of nourishment.
Ease and willing giving supply the beneficent economic role of the released flow.
Milk or rain pouring abundantly from its source joins nourishment and rainfall in one yield mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Midrār depicts the sky acting as a nourishing source whose freely given yield sustains life and prosperity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun ٱلسَّمَآءَ carries the packet's non-dominant س م و to و س م mapping, while مِّدْرَارًا anchors the rain output.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first rain visibly marks earth with vegetation, so the abundant descent functions like an inscription whose legible result is growth.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with vegetation turns the focus sky into the source of a visible growth-sign.
Abundant yielding supplies the rain that writes that vegetative mark into the ground.

changed_reading.after: The sky sends a rain whose abundance writes its visible sign into the earth as growth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb يُرْسِلِ can retain the messenger and message branch even though its grammatical object here is the sky.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispatched message normally bears meaningful content; here the content is materialized as abundant yield, allowing the rain to function as both provision and communication.

activation_trace.role: The messenger and message image makes the descending provision a dispatched bearer of meaning as well as matter.
Copious yield supplies the tangible content carried by that material message.

changed_reading.before: The rain is only a promised event.
changed_reading.after: The rain can also be a dispatched material message whose content is abundant provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening dispatches Noah, while the focus dispatches the sky. Repetition of the same sending mechanism lets the second dispatch enact materially what the first messenger announces verbally.

activation_trace.role: The messenger and message branch keeps semantic communication active inside the focus verb.
Abundant output gives the second dispatch a material payload rather than spoken content.
The opening dispatch of a messenger supplies the human-message pole that the focus's sky-dispatch can materially echo.

structural_cues: The first and focus ayat repeat the same causative sending verb with different dispatched objects.
The opening sending bears warning, while the focus sending bears the promised abundance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two sendings and the messenger/message image; I infer that the later material dispatch confirms or enacts the earlier verbal one. A live alternative is simple lexical recurrence between two otherwise separate acts.

changed_reading.before: Rain is a possible message because the focus verb can denote dispatching a messenger.
changed_reading.after: The opening dispatch of Noah makes the rain a second, materialized dispatch that confirms the warning-message with an observable yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, protective covering of fault and lordly repair or nurture supply a relational restoration; the focus then reads as release of a previously unavailable productive flow.

activation_trace.role: Release supplies the directional step from restored relation to opened provision.
Copious yielding supplies the concrete benefit released after the restoration.
Covering fault and protecting its bearer from the consequence supply the removal of relational obstruction.
Repair, nurture, and completion make the addressed Lord the agent who restores a productive condition.

structural_cues: The command to seek forgiveness and the intensive غَفَّارًا immediately precede the focus promise.
The focus continues with an unexpressed divine subject and a newly released object, the sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective forgiveness, restorative lordship, adjacency, and release; I supply the arrow that restored relation opens the supply. The alternative is a sequence of associated promises without a hydraulic causal relation.

changed_reading.before: The sky's abundant yield is a neutral physical gift.
changed_reading.after: The abundant yield is presented as reopened provision following protective forgiveness and restorative nurture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's nourishing yield becomes the upstream input to a connected extension: liquid is channelled as rivers, extended into assets and lineage, and embodied in tree-covered gardens.

activation_trace.role: Milk and continuous yield make the focus rain a nourishing input capable of supporting downstream products.
Abundant output from a source supplies the volume that the following chain distributes.
A river cutting the ground with running water supplies the channelized terminal form of the sky's yield.
Connected increase that supports another thing turns the verse's list into an extending production process.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies an economic output of the extended water provision.
Lineage and derivation from an origin supply the human-generational output of the extension.
An orchard concealed by its trees supplies the vegetative output built from sustained water.

structural_cues: Verse 12 directly coordinates extension, wealth, sons, gardens, and rivers after the focus.
The repeated وَيَجْعَلَ moves from received flow to durable environments and channels.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a coordinated list and branch images of connected increase, assets, lineage, orchard, and river; I infer a causal production chain beginning with rain. The live alternative is that these are parallel promises rather than material stages caused by one another.

changed_reading.before: The rain is itself the promised benefit.
changed_reading.after: The rain is upstream infrastructure whose connected yield becomes wealth, continuity of household, cultivated cover, and flowing channels.

context_deltas.mechanism: The split-root first-rain mark is developed by measured creation through successive states and by the explicit depiction of human beings as earth-grown plants; the rain's visible mark therefore includes formation of the addressees, not vegetation alone.

activation_trace.role: First rain marking earth with growth supplies the initial visible inscription made by the focus sky.
Abundant yielding supplies the water that sustains the mark beyond its first appearance.
Measured formation turns growth into an ordered process rather than an unstructured increase.
Successive stages provide the temporal sequence through which the rain-mark develops.
Human growth and nurture extend the vegetation mechanism directly to the people addressed by عَلَيْكُم.
Soft fertile earth supplies the receiving surface in which the rain-sign becomes living form.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from creation in stages to layered skies and then to people grown from earth as growth.
The focus's عَلَيْكُم addresses the same humans later cast as earth-grown life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a first-rain growth mark, stages, measured creation, fertile earth, and human growth; I infer that rain participates in the formation-sign carried by the addressees. The alternative is that the human plant comparison is independent of the promised rain.

changed_reading.before: The sky's first rain marks the ground with vegetation.
changed_reading.after: The abundant rain begins a measured, staged growth-mark in which even the addressees are portrayed as cultivated earth-life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dominant sky-cover and the context's superposed layers combine with the non-dominant narrow-opening branch to model a structured upper enclosure whose abundant flow is admitted through apertures or channels.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky or cover supplies the upper enclosure from which rain descends.
A narrow opening of entry supplies the focus noun's exploratory aperture through the upper enclosure.
Copious source-yield supplies the fluid forced or admitted through the proposed openings.
The plural overhead skies make the cover multiple and architecturally extended.
Layers placed one above another organize the upper covers into a stacked conduit system.

structural_cues: Verse 15 places plural skies and superposed layers in the same construction.
The focus supplies descent from that upper structure but does not name an opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overhead covers, stacked layers, a split-root narrow opening, and abundant outflow; I project the opening through the layers as the route of descent. The live alternative is the ordinary unarchitected image of rain from clouds or sky.

changed_reading.before: Rain descends generally from the sky.
changed_reading.after: Rain is released through an exploratory architecture of layered upper covers and narrow conduits.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reciprocal sending and circular return convert the focus's one-way descent into one leg of an exchange: sky sends water, the lower earth sends out growth, receives it back, and brings it out again.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal sending and matching make the sky's dispatch one side of an answering exchange.
Rotation and encircling supply the exploratory circuit linking descent, reception, return, and renewed emergence.
Plant growth emerging from earth supplies the upward answer to the sky's downward water.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the receiving and returning pole of the circuit.
Return after departure supplies the circuit's movement back into its receiving ground.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies renewed emergence from the ground.

structural_cues: Verses 17 and 18 move from earth-growth to return into earth and emphatic extraction from it.
Sky and earth form explicit upper and lower poles around the focus's عَلَيْكُم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal sending, rotation, earth-growth, return, and extraction; I join them into a sky-earth circuit. A live alternative is that verses 17-18 concern creation and resurrection analogically, not a material water cycle.

changed_reading.before: Rain is a one-way descent from sky to people.
changed_reading.after: The descent is one phase of a reciprocal sky-earth cycle of watering, growth, return, and renewed emergence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same wealth-and-descendants field first extends the rain promise and later appears under the repeated operator of increase ending only in loss. Abundance therefore amplifies an existing trajectory rather than independently certifying favor.

activation_trace.role: Ease, prosperity, and willing giving supply the initially beneficent reading that context then qualifies.
Abundant yielding supplies the increase whose outcome is shown to depend on its trajectory.
Increase and growth become the repeated operator that can compound loss as readily as provision.
Accumulated wealth supplies one promised output of the focus's productive flow.
The same accumulated-wealth image reappears as an amplifier that does not prevent loss.
Lineage from an origin supplies the promised family-continuity side of abundance.
Offspring from one's line repeats family increase inside the later loss-producing configuration.
General diminution supplies the terminal outcome that reverses the expected benefit of greater assets and offspring.

structural_cues: Verse 12 promises أَمْوَٰلٍ and بَنِينَ, while verse 21 repeats مَالُهُ and the family field as وَلَدُهُ.
The formula لَمْ يَزِدْهُ ... إِلَّا makes increase itself outcome-neutral until its complement names the result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated wealth, parallel descendant terms, increase, and loss; I infer that abundance amplifies relational direction rather than proving approval. The alternative is that verse 21 criticizes a particular leader's wealth and need not qualify the promise in verse 11.

changed_reading.before: Copious rain and its prosperity straightforwardly signal approval.
changed_reading.after: Copious provision is a capacity that can become flourishing or compound loss; abundance alone is not a verdict on its recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: Copious source-yield has a threshold: while bounded delivery nourishes, enough water to fill the receiving ground becomes churning engulfment and drowning. The later flood keeps force and danger latent inside midrār.

activation_trace.role: Abundant rain pouring from its source supplies the beneficial flow whose magnitude can cross a threshold.
A dangerous churning whirlpool keeps destabilizing and engulfing force available inside the focus root.
Drowning in water supplies the realized destructive endpoint of excessive flow.
Earth becoming full of water supplies the saturation threshold between productive rain and inundation.

structural_cues: The surah later states that the rejecting group was drowned after presenting rain, gardens, and rivers as provision.
Both the focus and the drowning episode place water over or around human recipients, but with opposite outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies copious rain, whirlpool danger, saturated ground, and drowning; I infer a shared water-force whose outcome changes at a threshold. The live alternative is that the promised rain and the later drowning are distinct events with no intended hydraulic continuity.

changed_reading.after: Midrār retains the force of water that nourishes while bounded but can become saturating and engulfing when its measure or relation reverses.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the non-dominant د ر ر to د و ر mapping and a later dayyār echo. It remains anchored because both the focus's midrār branch and 71:26's dayyār resolve to root_000499. Downstream prose should call it a form-distant occupancy echo, not an etymology of midrār or a claim that 71:11 itself predicts depopulation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier attaches only to مِّدْرَارًا through its packet-supplied root_000499 branches.

activation_trace.role: Circulation of states and turns of condition let the abundant sending register as a change in inhabited circumstances.
Attachment to a dwelling supplies the occupancy domain affected by that exploratory turn.
The d-y-r material and its no-soul idiom give dayyār the endpoint of an emptied inhabited domain.

changed_reading.after: Very tentatively, the abundant sending also sounds a turn of conditions reaching the inhabited dār and later shadowed by no dayyār.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pearl-bright branch is distant from the primary rain-yield sense, so this should not replace the hydrological reading. It remains anchored in مِّدْرَارًا and is activated by the same sky's moonlight and lamp imagery in 71:16. Downstream prose should present it only as a possible visual overlay: bright drops or rain-lines participating in the celestial display.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The outlier joins ٱلسَّمَآءَ to the pearl-like brightness branch of مِّدْرَارًا.

activation_trace.role: The overhead sky supplies the visual field in which the proposed bright shower appears.
Pearl-like clarity and brightness turn the falling abundance into a scintillating visual texture.
Illumination supplies the ambient light that activates the focus's pearl-bright branch.
A shining lamp supplies a concentrated celestial light source against which bright rain can be seen.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives the quantity and direction of rain.
changed_reading.after: As a contained visual activation, the verse can also show a pearl-bright shower across a sky organized by light and lamp.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This outlier is surprising because it activates the land-missed-by-rain branch from the root of khatī'āt and places it beside drowning. The branch is packet-backed and the comparison remains anchored in the focus's abundant rain, but downstream prose must not gloss khatī'āt as drought or claim that the two extremes are explicit in the surface wording; it should qualify the model as a cross-branch polarity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The model anchors in مِّدْرَارًا as abundant but potentially measured source-yield.

activation_trace.role: Abundant rain-yield supplies the productive middle whose adequacy is being tested against two extremes.
Land missed by rain supplies the deficient extreme of failed delivery without redefining the verse's surface noun.
Ground filled with water supplies the excessive extreme of delivery beyond absorption.

changed_reading.before: More rain is simply better rain.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, midrār becomes the controlled productive yield between rain that misses the land and water that saturates it into disaster.

strongest_changes: The repeated إرسال turns the rain into a material counterpart to the opening messenger-dispatch.
The immediate forgiveness sequence and verse 12 change rain from an isolated gift into reopened upstream infrastructure for a connected provision chain.
Growth, return, and extraction revise one-way descent into a reciprocal sky-earth circuit.
The later wealth-to-loss and water-to-drowning reversals prevent abundance from functioning as an unconditional sign of approval or safety.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest controls came from repeated sending, increase, wealth, and water, while the packet's split mappings preserved stranger but coherent mechanisms: س م و to و س م made first rain a growth-mark, س م و to س م م suggested apertures in layered cover, and د ر ر to د و ر opened circulation and occupancy echoes.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrow from forgiveness to opened rainfall is strongly sequenced but still reader-supplied rather than grammatically stated as a physical cause.
The growth-return sequence may be a creation and resurrection analogy rather than a material water cycle.
The layered-aperture and dwelling-turn readings depend on non-dominant mappings and require explicit exploratory qualification.
The later drowning may intentionally reverse the promised rain, or it may be a separate water event whose continuity is only abductive.
